overview_description.description:
PEGAfrica is an asset financing company currently selling Pay As You Go solar energy products to off-grid customers in Ghana, Cote d'Ivoire, and Senegal.  PEG’s Pay As You Go solar systems give our customers access to better quality light, mobile phone charging, and appliances like radios and televisions.  

Hugh Whalan and Nate Heller founded PEG in 2013. It has its headquarters in Accra in Ghana.
